clinical_intent: For a vaginal cylinder brachytherapy plan treating a vaginal cuff recurrence, the plan shows excellent coverage of the target with V100 = 98%, but the D2cc to the sigmoid is 65 Gy EQD2 and the D2cc to the bladder is 72 Gy EQD2. The patient also received 45 Gy EBRT to the pelvis. Evaluate whether these cumulative dose constraints are within acceptable limits and discuss any concerns.
